tests.name: Every gesture: 3D fixed-length bones, finger joints, grounded ankles, authoring limits
All 11 expressions settle as specified; neutral is not smiling
Frame counts, deterministic replay, 30/60 fps alignment
Subsecond cues have positive smooth envelopes and zero outside bounds
Explicit visemes override text; terminal shape closes; invalid timelines rejected
Audio silence stays still; stereo energy is measured without cancellation
Media master clock: low frame rate, pause, backwards seek, long jump
Canvas renderer executes full, closeup, transparent and debug modes
Browser event mocks: manual selection with audio, context and URL cleanup

notes: Geometry checks do not establish human realism.
Pixel speed comparison depends on gesture size and is not a quality score.
Browser event logic was tested with mocks; the real browser/audio-device path needs user playback.
